title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the final expression for mean-square displacement as <(Delta x)^2> = Tt/lambda.

title: Understanding Forces
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the role of the damping force and random force acting on the object.

title: Equation of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive or state the equation of motion for the object under the influence of forces.

title: Thermal Equilibrium
description: Important Criteria: The student should relate the average velocity squared to thermal equilibrium conditions, showing <v^2(t)> = kT/m.

title: Limit Behavior
description: Optional Criteria: The student should discuss the limit behavior of the derived expressions as time approaches infinity.

title: Proportionality Constant
description: Important Criteria: The student must identify and explain the proportionality constant lambda in relation to viscosity.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or misinterpretation of the forces involved.

title: Dimensional Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student may perform dimensional analysis to verify the consistency of the final expression.
